invariants.text: Book.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Book.author_id must reference an existing Author.id
Author.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Member.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Loan.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Loan.book_id must reference an existing Book.id
Loan.member_id must reference an existing Member.id
A book must have exactly one author, identified by author_id, and deleting an author cascades to remove all books associated with that author.
Deleting a book cascades to remove all loans associated with that book.
A loan is considered overdue if its due_date is earlier than today and return_date is null.
When a book is borrowed, its available_copies field is decremented by one, and if it reaches zero, the book still remains in the system with zero available copies.
When a book is returned, its available_copies field is incremented by one, and the loan status is set to 'returned' with return_date set to today.
Attempting to return a loan that is already marked as returned raises an AlreadyReturnedLoanError and does not modify any data.
The due date for a loan is calculated as 14 calendar days after the loan_date, and is computed by the LibraryService, not derived from book published_year.
A book's available_copies cannot be negative; borrowing the last copy sets it to zero, and no negative values are allowed.
A member's is_active field defaults to True when created, and renewing membership toggles its value between True and False.
Book search by query performs case-insensitive substring matching across title, author name, and ISBN, and returns each matching book only once even if multiple fields match.
